premise_families.statement: AI takes the elves' jobs, and displacement turns out to be funny in several directions.
No work, only orchestration: a swarm of agents supervises every elf.
The model confidently does the wrong thing, with one recurring motif.
The card itself is visibly written in AI-slop language.
AI solves a Christmas problem too hard.
Christmas becomes a data-driven policy state.
One word changes and everything sounds smarter; nothing else changes.
